title: Upcoming invoice methods removed
description: Basil removes upcoming invoice endpoints; creation of previews requires explicit subscription or scheduling context. Scoped to migration from SDK >=17.0.0 <18.0.0 to 18.0.0.
oldBehavior: Upcoming invoices could be retrieved with the old helpers.
newBehavior: Create a preview with explicit invoice context.
migrationInstructions: Migrate retrieveUpcoming/listUpcomingLines to the preview APIs and review their parameters.
